purpose: Teach: 試乗/躍進/ビデオカメラ/刻印/副題/休職/借用/発令

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験機の試乗、つまり試運転を担当しろ
lines.en: Ren, you'll handle the test ride of the experimental unit — the trial run, in other words.
lines.style: Firm but mentoring tone, name delivered like a tap on the shoulder, patient clarification on the rephrase.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究の躍進を目指し、論文を投稿します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll submit the paper — aiming for a real breakthrough in the research.
lines.style: Eager, slightly over-quick 'yes sir,' earnest student energy, voice steadying with resolve on 'breakthrough.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、フィールド調査でビデオカメラを使え
lines.en: Ren, use a video camera for the field survey.
lines.style: Short, practical instruction, unhurried and low, the tone of someone handing over a useful tool.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。試料に識別番号を刻印します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll engrave identification numbers on the samples.
lines.style: Careful, note-taking delivery, each word placed precisely, quiet pride at knowing the procedure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の副題を魅力的にしろ
lines.en: Ren, make the paper's subtitle something that actually draws people in.
lines.style: A knowing, almost fatherly push, slight lean on 'actually draws people in,' sharing hard-won wisdom.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の先輩の休職期間を考慮します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll take my lab senior's leave of absence into account, too.
lines.style: Softer, considerate register, slowing thoughtfully on the senior's situation, gentle conscientious finish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、図書館から論文を借用するな、複写しろ
lines.en: Ren — don't borrow the papers from the library. Make copies instead.
lines.style: Sharper correction, a beat of pause after the 'don't,' then the fix delivered clean and final.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費追加の発令を待ちます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll wait for the directive on the additional research funding.
lines.style: Composed closing acknowledgment, a touch of relief in the exhale, settling into patient readiness.
